narr: A weak cold front extended from West Tennessee into central Arkansas during the afternoon hours on July 8, 2023. This front was moving slowly south. This feature combined with strong instability and deep moisture resulted in numerous showers and thunderstorms across the Mid-South. Isolated wind damage and flash flooding occurred.
ev: Various roads were flooded southeast of the center of Jackson.
A vehicle was stranded in floodwater at Lambuth Boulevard and Princeton Street.
